'''Falsewings''' is a [[Common enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|The "Psuthopteron" (archive ID: ARA07C) has flight capabilities that are wholly unrelated to its morphology. This pattern was originally regarded as biomimicry. However, the modern consensus believes it was a mimic of Terran flying vehicles.}}

==Overview==
As one of the basic ranged [[Aggeloi]], Falsewings are slightly more threatening than [[Sting]]s, but it doesn't make them more of the threat; Aside from a shot, which deals Æther damage, they can now create a moving whirlwind that deals continuous Æther damage and slows Operators in it.
